epigraph: Belief is a weight the ground must hold.
vignette: The soldier stepped onto the cracked stone. He did not shout. He placed his palm flat against the dust. The stone warmed under his hand. A pulse of heat moved through the earth. It reached the feet of the three archers crouching nearby. They stood straighter. Their grips tightened on their bows. The air grew heavy with shared purpose. The ground accepted the shape of their unity. It hardened into a new truth. This was the Rallying Cry. It asked for one heartbeat of belief. It gave them strength that did not fade. The enemy line wavered. They saw the stillness of the Verdant guard. They saw the focus of the Umbral strike. The ground beneath the allies glowed faint gold or deep red. The power settled into the soil. It remained. It was a permanent shift in the weight of the world. The archers drew their strings. The target was clear. The belief held them steady. The stone remembered the pressure of the hand. It would not forget.
codex_note: Scholars note that unity inscribed into the strata creates a localized gravity of conviction that anchors adjacent combatants.
